_comment: One safe sentence per year or decade, spoken while the read settles — Add Item Ideas 4d/4e. Era facts live in this reviewed file, not the model's memory, so nothing invented reaches a collector who knows better. Exact year wins over decade. Keep each line checkable and never about value or price.
1943: 1943 — wartime stock. They cut corners that year…
1944: 1944 — wartime paper, thinner than the years around it…
1910s: A 1910s issue — early days for these…
1920s: A 1920s tag — before the numbered-county systems settled…
1930s: A Depression year. Nobody bought these for fun…
1940s: A 1940s issue — war years either side of it…
1950s: A 1950s tag — the boom years for small-town hunting…
1960s: A 1960s issue — the last of the pin-back era in most states…
1970s: A 1970s issue — late for a back tag, early for plastic…
